Container.Name: cih-analyzer
Container.Overview: Works out, once per file and offline, which part of the 16:9 frame holds the picture at every moment (letterbox, pillarbox, windowbox, films that change ratio, gradual matte moves) and serves that timeline over HTTP, so a player can scale the picture automatically on a constant-image-height projector setup. It only reads your media (mount every library read-only), never writes to it, and pauses while Plex is transcoding. The web page shows the queue, progress, errors and each title's timeline.
Container.Requires: Optional: a Plex server (for Plex ids, recently-added priority and pausing during transcodes).

Config.Name: Web UI and API port
Config.Description: LAN only. The status page is at this port; the player add-on reads timelines from /api/v1/timeline.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: The database (timelines, queue, overrides). Keep it: re-analysing a library takes days.

Config.Name: Library: Music Videos
Config.Description: Mount each library read-only. Start with one small library to measure speed; leave the others empty and add them later. The folder name under /media must match a PATH_MAP rule.

Config.Name: Library: TV Shows
Config.Description: Read-only. Large: set SAMPLE_INTERVALS (for example /media/tv=8) before mounting it.

Config.Name: Library: Other 1
Config.Description: Read-only. Any further library; add its PATH_MAP rule.

Config.Name: PATH_MAP
Config.Description: Type this in yourself (a default is not used because Unraid turns a | in a default into a drop-down). Equivalent names for the same folder: one rule per library, rules separated by ; and the names inside a rule separated by | . The first name is the path inside this container, then Plex's path for the library, then the Unraid path. Example: /media/musicvideos|/musicvideos|/mnt/user/media/Music Videos

Config.Name: MEDIA_ROOTS
Config.Description: Folders to scan, separated by ; Everything mounted under /media is scanned.

Config.Name: PLEX_URL
Config.Description: For example http://192.168.1.10:32400 Leave empty to run without Plex.

Config.Name: PLEX_TOKEN
Config.Description: Your Plex token. Only read from here; never stored in the image or written to logs.

Config.Name: PLEX_SKIP_SECTIONS
Config.Description: Plex library titles to ignore, separated by ; (only affects Plex ids; what is analysed is what you mount).

Config.Name: API_KEY
Config.Description: If set, the API needs this as the X-Api-Key header. The status page asks for it once.

Config.Name: CONCURRENCY
Config.Description: Files analysed at once when the container first starts. Each runs at the lowest CPU and disk priority. Once you change the count on the status page it is saved and wins over this setting.

Config.Name: QUIET_HOURS
Config.Description: Optional HH:MM-HH:MM (local time) when analysis pauses, for example 18:00-23:30.

Config.Name: PAUSE_ON_TRANSCODE
Config.Description: 1 pauses analysis while Plex is transcoding video; 0 never pauses.

Config.Name: SAMPLE_INTERVAL
Config.Description: Seconds between the keyframes the first pass looks at. Larger is faster and can miss a very short change (at least 1).

Config.Name: SAMPLE_INTERVALS
Config.Description: Per-folder overrides, for example /media/tv=8 ; longest folder wins.

Config.Name: SCAN_INTERVAL
Config.Description: Seconds between scans of the media folders.

Config.Name: PLEX_INTERVAL
Config.Description: Seconds between reads of Plex's libraries.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone, used for quiet hours and for the times on the status page.
